turns.question: Which customer has spent the most with us over all their orders, and how much?
turns.answer: Customer 10 has spent the most with us, at 2,356.00 EUR in revenue from non-cancelled orders over all time (2000-01-01 to 2040-12-31, the whole range the semantic layer allows). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
